newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares edge just higher in IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares edge just higher in IBIS trade.

text.p: 1610 GMT - German shares edge slightly higher to close post-bourse dealings just above their bourse session close. Wall Street advance, buoyant DTB DAX futures support gains. 3,000 points still seen a target for the DAX.
* IBIS DAX index ends up 19.56 points at 2,996.12, just shy of all-time intraday high of 2,998.79.
* March DTB DAX futures up 21.5 points at 3,011.5.
* Daimler-Benz dips, but report that Mercedes chief to leave the group had little impact, dealers cite profit-taking after stock hit record highs.
